target_customer: Fortune 500 companies, marketplaces and regulated financial institutions with fraud, KYC and compliance review teams (originally trust and safety teams at online platforms)
problem: Fraud, identity and compliance investigations need large amounts of manual evidence gathering. Variance agents collect evidence and produce audit-ready case traces.
business_model: Enterprise B2B software sold to fraud and compliance teams
product_category: AI agents for fraud, KYC/KYB and transaction monitoring investigations

founders.name: Karine Mellata
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: Trust and Safety machine learning and data engineering infrastructure. Education not found.

founders.name: Michael Lin
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. Education not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Trust and safety tooling at founding was data engineering and ML infrastructure; the later agent platform adds LLM reliability and auditability demands.

defensibility.rationale: Regulated buyers need audit trails and integrations, which create some lock-in, but rival fraud and moderation vendors were established.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not verified with dated sources; the company pivoted in 2025 to financial crime instead of competing on moderation.

market_need_then: Platforms faced rising trust and safety obligations and fraud volume, and founders had seen the problem at Apple and Discord.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct; stresses trust, auditability and explainability

rebrands.why: Coincided with the pivot from trust and safety to financial crime; reason for the new name not stated in sources

brand_strength.rationale: Enterprise brand known mainly through funding coverage and a YC video; no community or mascot found.

pivots.from: Intrinsic, trust and safety tooling for content moderation
pivots.to: Variance, AI agents for fraud, identity and financial crime investigations
pivots.why: Search coverage says the company moved to banking and compliance; the stated reason is not public in sources found

outcome_analysis: Variance began as Intrinsic, a trust and safety startup in W23, and pivoted around 2025 to AI agents for financial crime investigations. The shift to regulated buyers and the LLM agent wave supported a $21.5M Series A led by Ten Eleven Ventures in March 2026. It is active with a team of about a dozen.
notes: A seed of about 3.1M in early 2024 appears only in aggregator profiles and is unverified, so not recorded as a round. Totals conflict (26M vs 33.4M). Competitor names (Sift, Hive, ActiveFence, Two Hat) came only from an undated profile page, so the dated list is empty. Pivot date from search summaries, not a primary source. Founding year 2022 per YC, some sources say 2023.
